title: Natural-power form of a moment comparison
statement: Let $m,k$ be natural numbers and let $B,M,D$ be nonnegative real numbers. If $D^kB\leq M^{2(m+1)/(2m+1)}$, then $(D^kB)^{2m+1}\leq M^{2(m+1)}$.
replaced: Let $m,k\ge0$ be integers and let $B,M,D\ge0$. If $D^kB\le M^{2(m+1)/(2m+1)}$, then $(D^kB)^{2m+1}\le M^{2(m+1)}$, using natural powers and $0^0=1$.
